notes.title: Playtesting Update
notes.content:
We just published the latest Panta Rhei playtesting build featured at Game Access Brno and Creativity Rules! Note that this is still an early combat and core mechanic testing build.

We are planning to update this build in preparation for the upcoming events!

Features:
- Combat-focused core loop with core time manipulation mechanics
- First tests regarding the final visual direction and lighting
- First tests regarding the inventory management and power crafting system
- First iteration of the "Fragment" skill tree

notes.title: September Playtesting Release
notes.content:
The September updates the core gameplay loop and introduces more rogue-like elements and a first test at a more exploration-driven experience.

Updates:
- New map setup with dynamically generated areas
- Main progression with 3 unlockable chrono abilities
- Updated Reversion abilities
- More focus on traps and environmental interactions
